title: Juicy Thai Chicken Noodles
description: A kid-friendly Southern Thai dish featuring lardons and a cheese-pull, made with macrobiotic-friendly ingredients and a hint of white vinegar.
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and add the rendered lardons.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, palm sugar, and white vinegar.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and lardons, and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the chicken and sauce.
Transfer the noodles to a serving platter and top with chopped scallions.
Garnish with additional scallions if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days.
